offlineHint: One device, one mission. Each person advocates for their goals and votes on changes before they take effect.
onlineHint: Connect to a Socket.IO server to share design, decisions and simulation. Local mode always works without a server.
name: Name
serverHint: The static demo needs a server hosted by your team. Use HTTPS when this page uses HTTPS.
goal_director: Keep 20% of the budget in reserve for surprises.
goal_engineering: Keep mass within launch capacity and generate all the power you need.
goal_science: Increase scientific value to 10 points per day.
goal_operations: Download at least as much data as you generate.
tradeoff: More instruments help Science, but use mass, energy, budget and bandwidth. Negotiate a balance.
voted: Your vote is recorded. Wait for the next crew member.
majority: A strict majority is required. A final tie rejects the proposal.
noPending: No pending proposals. Edit any mission decision to submit a change for a vote.
launchHint: Launch authorization and event responses also require a vote.
waitCrew: Wait for another player: an online mission needs at least two crew members.
hostClock: The coordinator advances the simulation; everyone votes on event responses.
emptyChat: Chat belongs to this room and disappears when the room closes.
reconnectHint: Disconnecting releases your place. Join again with the code if the room is still open.
error_INVALID_INPUT: Check names (1–24 characters), the room code and your input.
error_ROOM_NOT_FOUND: No room has that code. Check that it is still open.
error_ROOM_FULL: The room already has four players.
error_ALREADY_IN_ROOM: You are already in a room. Leave it before joining another.
error_NOT_IN_ROOM: Assemble a local crew or join a room first.
error_NOT_HOST: Only the coordinator can advance the simulation.
error_WRONG_PHASE: This decision is unavailable in the current phase.
error_PROPOSAL_PENDING: A proposal is pending. Vote before suggesting another change.
error_PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND: This proposal is no longer pending.
error_NEED_TEAM: At least two players are needed to launch.
error_RATE_LIMIT: Too many actions in a short time. Wait a moment.
error_INVALID_RESPONSE: This response is unavailable for the event.
error_STALE_DESIGN: The room changed. Review its current state and propose again.
error_MISSION_NOT_FINISHED: Finish the remaining days and event decisions before the report.
error_CONNECTION_FAILED: Connection failed. Check the server URL, CORS settings and whether it is running.
error_NOT_CONNECTED: Assemble a local crew or connect to a room to continue as a team.
error_INVALID_SERVER: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials.
error_SEED_LOCKED: The seed is locked when the crew is assembled. Leave the room to change it.
error_TIMEOUT: The server did not respond in time. Try connecting again.
